fx_snapshot.source_label: BSP Philippine peso per US dollar, 23 September 2026; reviewed Batch 13 observation carried forward explicitly

operating_earnings.rationale: Reuse the finite Batch 9 operating P/E screening band for positive aligned TTM EPS; not a peer study or intrinsic FCFF/SOTP.

review_book.rationale: Reuse the conservative Batch 14 filing-review P/B band when reported per-share book value is usable only as a preliminary screen.

layered_book.rationale: Reuse the Batch 12 layered-holding P/B band for mixed components and unresolved parent claims; not a completed SOTP.

bank_book.rationale: Reuse the Batch 5 lender-review P/B band while common-share/BVPS and interim parent-capital bases remain unreconciled.

industrial_book.rationale: Reuse the Batch 13 cyclical-industrial P/B band while current manufacturing cash flows and reinvestment remain unresolved.

stressed_sales.rationale: Reuse the Batch 9 stressed-food finite P/S band when EPS and common-book claims are not usable; no peer calibration or intrinsic equity bridge.

source.label: AXLM FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

normalization.formula: 0.22 FY2025 basic EPS + 0.11 1H2026 EPS - 0.06 prior 1H EPS

AXLM.route_reason: Export manufacturing margins, working capital and reinvestment require FCFF; P/E is a finite separate screen.
AXLM.intrinsic_blocker: Coconut-product volume and price mix, export FX, input costs, capex, debt, minority and terminal economics are not reconciled.
AXLM.source_warning: The P/E band is not peer-calibrated and 1H2026 sales were below prior-year 1H despite higher earnings.

source.label: BALAI FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

supporting_sources.label: BALAI PSE company information and FRUIT relationship

normalization.formula: reported PHP book value per share; do not substitute zero parent-attribution fields

BALAI.route_reason: Store cohorts, brand margins, leases and reinvestment require FCFF; reported BVPS supplies only a finite screen.
BALAI.intrinsic_blocker: Store-level economics, parent attribution, FRUIT ownership, leases, capex, debt and terminal cash flows are not reconciled.
BALAI.source_warning: PSE summary parent equity and income fields appear as zero while total equity and BVPS are positive; they are treated as unavailable, not economic zero. BALAI is FRUIT-related and per-share screens are non-additive.

source.label: FCG June FY2025 and 9M FY2026 PSE financial summary

FCG.metric_label: TTM basic EPS through March 2026, June fiscal year

normalization.formula: 0.12 FY2025 basic EPS + 0.08 9M FY2026 EPS - 0.08 prior 9M EPS

FCG.route_reason: Brand/store cash flows and leases require FCFF; P/E is a finite separate screen on aligned June fiscal periods.
FCG.intrinsic_blocker: Store cohorts, franchise mix, leases, restructuring, capital spending, debt and terminal economics are not reconciled.
FCG.source_warning: FCG uses a June fiscal year; the March 2026 nine-month report is not a completed June 2026 annual result, and the PSE summary omits parent-equity attribution.

source.label: FOOD FY2025 and 1H2026 USD PSE financial summary

FOOD.metric_label: TTM USD revenue per outstanding common share translated to PHP
FOOD.route_reason: Seafood operating components and restructuring require SOTP/FCFF; a low finite sales multiple is a separate screen while losses and common claims are unresolved.
FOOD.intrinsic_blocker: Operating cash flows, restructuring, dilution, debt, minority claims, FX and current common-equity capital bridge are not reconciled.
FOOD.source_warning: FOOD reported losses, sharply lower 1H revenue and a proposed September equity restructuring; PSE BVPS is rounded to zero. This USD-to-PHP P/S screen uses a dated 23 September BSP observation and is not a price target.

source.label: SFI FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary, PHP thousands

supporting_sources.label: SFI listed common-share stock data, not preferred

SFI.metric_label: TTM PHP revenue per outstanding ordinary common share
SFI.route_reason: Poultry cash flows and capacity/restructuring require FCFF; a finite P/S screen avoids unusable reported common-book and rounded negative EPS.
SFI.intrinsic_blocker: Common versus convertible-preferred capital claims, parent equity, negative operating earnings, maintenance spending, financing and terminal cash flows are not reconciled.
SFI.source_warning: SFI has convertible preferred shares, losses and very low revenue. Its reported BVPS of 1 does not reconcile to total equity divided by listed common shares; the tiny P/S screen is not intrinsic or an actionable price target.

source.label: BNCOM FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

normalization.formula: reported PHP book value per share; not independently reconciled to ordinary shares

BNCOM.route_reason: Residual income remains the bank's primary intrinsic route; P/B is a separate finite screen pending common-capital reconciliation.
BNCOM.intrinsic_blocker: The PSE interim parent-equity field is blank and reported BVPS does not reconcile to 1,403,013,920 listed common shares; capital quality, dilution and cost-of-equity bridge remain unresolved.
BNCOM.source_warning: Reported 1H2026 equity of PHP36.373bn divided by listed common shares implies about PHP25.93, not the reported PHP22.08 BVPS. Do not infer missing parent equity or use this P/B screen as intrinsic residual income.
